dict.string: Trackify needs your location while open and in the background to show real-time vehicle tracking on the map, record trip routes, monitor safe parking, and send geofence alerts.

Trackify needs continuous background location to record your trip routes in real-time, send immediate safe parking and geofence breach alerts, and enable live location sharing even when the app is in the background.
Trackify needs your location to display your position relative to your vehicles on the map, help you set up geofences, find nearby fuel stations, and navigate routes.
Trackify requires camera access to scan QR codes on GPS tracking devices and Reach-Me stickers for quick pairing, and to capture vehicle documents.
Trackify requires photo library access to upload vehicle registration documents, profile pictures, and device QR code images from your gallery.
Trackify requires microphone access for audio recording during in-app video feedback and customer support recordings.
Trackify requires permission to save generated trip reports, receipts, and vehicle documents to your photo library.
